chunks: Muhammad ibn Hammam narrated to us, saying: Abu Ali al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Isa al-Qohistani narrated to us, saying: Badr ibn Ishaq ibn Badr al-Anmati narrated to us in the Night Market in Mecca - he was a precious elder from our virtuous brothers, and was from the people of Qazvin - in the year 265 AH, saying: My father Ishaq ibn Badr narrated to me, saying: My grandfather Badr ibn Isa narrated to me, saying: I asked my father Isa ibn Musa - who was a respectable man:

I said to him: 'Whom of the Successors (Tabi'un) did you meet?' He said: 'I do not know what you mean, but I was in Kufa, and I heard an old man in its mosque talking about Abd al-Khair. He said: 'I heard Amir al-Mu'minin Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) saying: The Messenger of Allah said to me: O Ali, the guided, upright, infallible Imams from your progeny are eleven Imams, and you are the first of them. The last of them has the same name as me. He will appear and fill the earth with justice, as it was filled with tyranny and oppression. A man will come to him with accumulated wealth, and say: O Mahdi, give to me. He will say: Take.'

key_terms.يَمْلَأُ الْأَرْضَ عَدْلًا: He will fill the earth with justice

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say to Ali about the Imams from his progeny?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Nu'mani’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* establishes the doctrine of *Ismah* (infallibility) and the specific number of twelve Imams through a direct prophetic declaration to Ali ibn Abi Talib. It highlights the eschatological role of the final Imam, whose name mirrors the Prophet's, in establishing universal justice (*adl*) to counteract tyranny, a theme central to Shia messianic expectation.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (23) Muhammad bin Hammam narrated from Abu Ali al-Hasan bin Ali bin Eessa al-Qoohistani from Badr bin Iss’haq bin Badr al-Anmati from his father that his grandfather Badr bin Eessa had said: Once I asked my father, who was a very respectable man:

“Whom have you met of the successors of the Prophet’s companions?” He said: “I do not know what you say but once I was in Kufa and heard an old man in the mosque talking about a good man. He said: “I have heard Amirul Mo’mineen Ali bin Abu Talib (as) saying: The Prophet (S) has said to me: O Ali, the infallible guided imams of your progeny are eleven ones and you are the first of them. The name of the last of them is like my name. He will appear to fill the world with justice and equity after it has been filled with injustice and oppression. People will come to him asking for money, which will be accumulated. He will say to them: “Take (as you like)!”
